component_data_script:
rows = props.get("rows") or []
if isinstance(rows, str):
	try:
		rows = json.loads(rows)
	except Exception:
		rows = [line for line in rows.split("\n") if line.strip()]
if not isinstance(rows, list):
	rows = []

style = "plans" if str(props.get("variant") or "") == "plans" else "days"
head = str(props.get("head") or "").strip()
head_cells = [cell.strip() for cell in head.split("|")] if head else []
records = []
count = len(head_cells)
for raw in rows:
	cells = [cell.strip() for cell in str(raw).split("|")]
	if not cells or not cells[0]:
		continue
	records.append(cells)
	count = max(count, len(cells))
count = max(count, 1)
if style == "plans":
	cols = "minmax(0, 40fr) repeat(" + str(max(count - 1, 1)) + ", minmax(0, 20fr))"
elif count == 3:
	cols = "minmax(0, 22fr) minmax(0, 26fr) minmax(0, 52fr)"
else:
	cols = "minmax(0, 1.2fr) repeat(" + str(max(count - 1, 1)) + ", minmax(0, 1fr))"
out = []
for cells in records:
	row = []
	for k in range(count):
		value = cells[k] if k < len(cells) else ""
		row.append({
			"label": head_cells[k] if k < len(head_cells) else "",
			"text": value,
			"role": "rowheader" if k == 0 else "cell",
			"first": "true" if k == 0 else "false",
			"col": str(k + 1),
			"fig": "true" if k > 0 and len(value) > 0 and value[0].isdigit() else "false",
		})
	out.append({"cells": row})
caption = str(props.get("caption") or "").strip()
component.rows = out
component.head_cells = [{"text": cell} for cell in head_cells]
component.has_head = len(head_cells) > 0
component.cols = cols
component.style = style
component.caption = caption
component.has_caption = len(caption) > 0
